answer: Grant influence only from attestations arriving from outside the attested identity own cluster. A sybil farm puppets all sit on one island, so their cross-attestations never lift one another; to reach the summit of influence, an attacker must earn attestations from many genuinely distinct clusters, each requiring real useful work, which breaks the economics of faking at scale. Correlated-creation signals can still spiral into false positives, and honest newcomers start isolated too, so clusters must be recomputed often and weighted by behavioral diversity, not just history.
